description: Use this when the person asks what has happened on a case so far. Input: the case `id`. Returns the events the person may see, oldest first, each with what happened, the state before and after, and when. Do not use this for where the case stands now (use evictions_get_case) or for messages (use evictions_list_case_messages). Needs the person’s account: sign-in or an API key.

id.description: The case id (case_...), as returned by evictions_create_case or evictions_list_cases.

name: evictions_get_case_events
title: Case events
